closure_target: complete federal programme and implementing-office inventory with terminated, retained, renamed, consolidated, appealed, corrected, and no-action dispositions
coverage_statement: The executive orders, OPM memoranda, Attorney General implementation memorandum, OFCCP disposition page, and Foreign Service directive expose a bounded cross-government programme and office implementation surface, including termination, RIF, retention, transfer, reorganization, and administrative-closure instructions. They do not expose the complete agency-by-agency programme, office, budget, position, disposition, appeal, correction, and no-action inventory.
included_rows: named executive-wide inventory and termination requirements
OPM initial, RIF, and further implementation instructions
OFCCP cease-and-desist, abeyance, resumed statutory programmes, and administrative closure rows
unavailable_rows: complete agency inventory submissions to OMB and OPM
complete programme, office, position, budget, retained-function, renamed, consolidated, appealed, corrected, and no-action rows
versioned agency implementation instructions and final dispositions
refused_rows: executive-wide instructions are not treated as completed agency inventories
named agency examples are not treated as the complete federal denominator
administrative closure is not treated as proof of programme merit, motive, prevalence, or complete consequence
negative_search_statement: The bounded official source set exposes mandatory inventory and implementation requirements but not the complete submitted inventories or final agency dispositions.
correction_route: FOIA, inspector-general, congressional, administrative, and judicial review

closure_target: complete employee, beneficiary, applicant, regulated-person, and otherwise affected-party roster including included, excluded, burdened, corrected, and no-observed-effect rows
coverage_statement: The OPM RIF and retained-function guidance, Foreign Service evaluation and promotion rules, Ames record, and federal workforce and research-grant cases identify bounded employee, applicant, grantee, and affected-party categories. They do not provide a complete person-level roster of included, excluded, burdened, corrected, unaffected, and unresolved rows.
included_rows: employees assigned to DEIA offices and functions
Foreign Service members subject to changed evaluation and promotion criteria
Ames employment litigants and adjudicated burden rule
federal workers and UC researchers represented in bounded official cases
unavailable_rows: complete employee, applicant, beneficiary, contractor-worker, grantee, regulated-person, and affected-party rosters
person-level eligibility, exclusion, burden, correction, and no-observed-effect rows
refused_rows: class allegations are not treated as a complete class roster
formal coverage categories are not treated as observed affected persons
named litigants are not treated as prevalence, motive, racial-order, or system-wide burden findings
negative_search_statement: No complete source-addressed affected-party roster was exposed; only bounded categories, named litigants, and represented classes were recovered.
correction_route: agency personnel, programme, grant, and enforcement records
administrative, judicial, legislative, union, and inspector-general review

closure_target: material burden, collective-claim, distributional consequence, and recurrence ledger with affected and comparator rows
coverage_statement: The Ames docket, grant and workforce cases, programme terminations, scholarship and grant resolutions, university agreements, and environmental-enforcement dispositions expose bounded burdens, collective claims, substitutions, and correction attempts. They do not form a complete distributional consequence, comparator, recurrence, durability, and no-effect ledger.
included_rows: named employment, research-grant, scholarship, funding, and environmental-enforcement burdens
bounded collective claims and class requests
programme termination, suspension, agreement, and litigation responses
unavailable_rows: complete material burden and distributional consequence rows
recurrence, duration, substitution, no-effect, reversal, and durability records
refused_rows: one lawsuit or settlement is not treated as system-wide burden or remedy adequacy
programme termination is not treated as proof of net benefit or harm
recurrence across sources is not treated as prevalence or common purpose
negative_search_statement: The official record exposes multiple bounded burden and correction surfaces but not a complete joined consequence and comparator denominator.
correction_route: case dockets and final merits records
administrative, judicial, legislative, collective-bargaining, and public-value review
